reader_summary.overview: This is the second episode of our multi-part series on the video game console market. If you've yet to listen to Episode One, Sia Kamalie is the founder and fund manager at Skycatcher. Join me in breaking down the video game console market and his thesis for why it's an inflecting opportunity.

key_points.text: In this episode, we go micro and Sia is back to break down Sony.
Sia and I spend a lot of time talking about catalysts and some of the dynamics that are happening under the hood of this massive conglomerate..
Please enjoy this Breakdown on Sony.
